title: NBN POI 3HAW (Hawthorn) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Planned maintenance at the NBN Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne was completed as scheduled on Tuesday 8 September 2026 at 2:00 AM AEST. Services were rehomed to new network equipment, and may have experienced a brief disruption of up to 2 hours during the maintenance window. Services should now be operating normally.

updates.content:
We will be performing planned maintenance affecting some NBN services served by the Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne.

When:
Tuesday 8 September 2026, 12:00 AM–2:00 AM AEST.

What you may experience:
- Interruption to NBN connectivity during the window (up to 2 hours).
- Brief dropouts as services are moved to new network equipment.

What we’re doing:
Our team will rehome services at this POI to improve network capacity and resilience. We’ll work to keep any interruption as short as possible.

What you can do:
No action is needed. Services should restore automatically after the window. If your service remains offline after 2:00 AM, please restart your modem/router. If issues persist, contact our support team.

The planned maintenance for NBN services at the Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne remains scheduled for Tuesday 8 September 2026 between 12:00 AM and 2:00 AM AEST. No changes to the maintenance window, expected impact, or restoration estimate have been made. The previously communicated information is still accurate.

The planned maintenance for NBN services at the Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne has been completed as scheduled. All service rehoming activities were finished by 2:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 8 September 2026. Services should now be operating as normal. If your service remains offline, please restart your modem/router.
